examples.title: Playful choices
examples.description: A clear choice, with room for personality.
principles: The round logo establishes the identity before the message.
A shaped orange band connects the headline to the choices.
Equal cards, consistent buttons and dark text make the choices easy to compare.

source.campaign: %FIRSTNAME% They've got energy. We've got options!

examples.title: Glow & momentum
examples.description: One vivid focal point, followed by a clear next step.
principles: The glow belongs to the logo; the body copy has a quiet, high-contrast surface.
Orange and sky blue separate the message from the next action.
The supporting copy and the action stay visually separate from the glow.

examples.title: Seasonal celebration
examples.description: A seasonal palette with the TIGAR identity still in focus.
principles: The gold circle anchors the seasonal design.
The headline, logo and single action have distinct places in the composition.
The red and gold come from the supplied holiday artwork and sent gift-card campaign.

vectorNote: The black and white SVG logos are vector reconstructions of the supplied artwork, not original designer masters. Confirm the final production proof with your supplier; embroidery requires a separate stitch file.
